content.description: Excludes onion, garlic and other alliums. A common cooking style across South India for everyday meals, festival food and temple kitchens.
content.rationale: Cooks who avoid alliums lean on asafoetida for savoury depth and on ginger, curry leaves and pepper for aroma.

requires: use asafoetida for savoury depth in place of alliums
structure.common_substitution_strategy: Add a pinch more asafoetida to the tempering; lean on ginger, curry leaves and black pepper for aroma.
